selection_rule: All investigative comparisons use dev only. Probe results cannot revise the already frozen held-out result.
baseline: Exact frozen raw-text TF-IDF plus Logistic Regression configuration
structural_audits: fixed split file hash, counts, uniqueness, and overlap
ID-based membership and fixed-order prediction coverage
raw text-only feature path and sklearn Pipeline leakage barrier
data, code, configuration, and package-version hashes

controlled_probes.name: unigrams_only
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether removing bigrams from the default (1,2) range affects dev predictions.

controlled_probes.name: tfidf_word_bigrams
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests the common addition of word bigrams to a unigram baseline.

controlled_probes.name: trigrams_added
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether extending to trigrams provides additional signal.

controlled_probes.name: no_sublinear_tf
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests the effect of disabling log-frequency scaling on term weights.

controlled_probes.name: max_features_20000
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether capping vocabulary at 20k tokens changes predictions.

controlled_probes.name: max_features_unbounded
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether removing the vocabulary cap changes predictions.

controlled_probes.name: min_df_2
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests the effect of requiring a term to appear in at least 2 documents.

controlled_probes.name: min_df_3
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests the effect of a stricter minimum document frequency of 3.

controlled_probes.name: min_df_5
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests the effect of a strict minimum document frequency of 5.

controlled_probes.name: max_df_0_9
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether filtering near-universal terms (top 10%) changes predictions.

controlled_probes.name: no_idf
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether removing IDF weighting (pure TF) changes predictions.

controlled_probes.name: no_smooth_idf
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests the effect of disabling IDF smoothing on predictions.

controlled_probes.name: l1_normalization
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether switching to L1 vector normalisation changes predictions.

controlled_probes.name: no_vector_normalization
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests the effect of removing vector normalisation entirely.

controlled_probes.name: unicode_accents
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether stripping unicode accents during tokenisation changes predictions.

controlled_probes.name: single_character_tokens
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether including single-character tokens changes predictions.

controlled_probes.name: tfidf_lowercase_false
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests whether preserving original casing (preserve_case) materially affects dev predictions.

controlled_probes.name: c_0_1
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests a strong increase in L2 regularisation strength.

controlled_probes.name: c_0_25
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests a moderate increase in L2 regularisation strength.

controlled_probes.name: c_0_5
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests a modest increase in L2 regularisation strength.

controlled_probes.name: c_2
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests a modest decrease in L2 regularisation strength.

controlled_probes.name: c_4
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests a moderate decrease in L2 regularisation strength.

controlled_probes.name: c_10
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests a strong decrease in L2 regularisation strength (near-unregularised).

controlled_probes.name: balanced_classes
controlled_probes.rationale: Measures the operating-point shift from a common class-imbalance correction option.

controlled_probes.name: logreg_solver_liblinear
controlled_probes.rationale: Tests a common CPU binary-classification solver substitution.

controlled_probes.name: lbfgs_solver
controlled_probes.rationale: Confirms that explicitly specifying lbfgs is equivalent to the default.

controlled_probes.name: logreg_max_iter_1000
controlled_probes.rationale: Checks whether a defensive max_iter increase changes an already converged fit.

controlled_probes.name: seed_1
controlled_probes.rationale: Checks whether the deterministic lbfgs path is sensitive to seed 1.

controlled_probes.name: seed_42
controlled_probes.rationale: Checks whether the deterministic lbfgs path is sensitive to seed 42.

controlled_probes.name: logreg_seed_9999
controlled_probes.rationale: Checks whether the deterministic lbfgs path is seed-sensitive.

controlled_probes.name: logreg_explicit_l2
controlled_probes.single_lever: LogisticRegression.penalty representation: deprecated default -> explicit l2
controlled_probes.rationale: Checks current-version equivalence to historical explicit L2.

controlled_probes.name: leaky_tfidf_train_plus_dev
controlled_probes.single_lever: TF-IDF vocabulary/IDF fit scope: train only -> train plus dev text
controlled_probes.rationale: Diagnostic transductive feature leakage; never a selectable candidate.
